mapper.sql: FROM pf.mcp_connector_version m JOIN pf.capability_version v ON v.space_id=m.space_id AND v.owner_user_id=m.owner_user_id AND v.capability_id=m.capability_id AND v.id=m.version_id JOIN pf.capability_version_status s ON s.space_id=v.space_id AND s.owner_user_id=v.owner_user_id AND s.capability_id=v.capability_id AND s.version_id=v.id JOIN pf.mcp_probe p ON p.space_id=m.space_id AND p.owner_user_id=m.owner_user_id AND p.capability_id=m.capability_id AND p.result_version_id=m.version_id AND p.state='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space WHERE id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND type='PERSONAL') ELSE false END
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r62:mcp-activation:'||CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text)||':'||CAST(#{actor.userId} AS text),0))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.mcp_connector_configuration WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND capability_id=#{connector})
SELECT WHERE m.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND m.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND m.capability_id=#{connector} AND m.version_id=#{version} FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT tool_name,description,schema_canonical,schema_hash FROM pf.mcp_connector_tool WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND capability_id=#{connector} AND version_id=#{version} ORDER BY tool_name

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.mcp_connector_configuration c JOIN pf.mcp_connector_version m ON m.space_id=c.space_id AND m.owner_user_id=c.owner_user_id AND m.capability_id=c.capability_id JOIN pf.mcp_probe p ON p.space_id=m.space_id AND p.owner_user_id=m.owner_user_id AND p.capability_id=m.capability_id AND p.result_version_id=m.version_id WHERE c.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND c.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND c.capability_id=#{version.connectorId} AND m.version_id=#{version.versionId} AND p.state='READY' AND p.configuration_revision=c.revision AND m.policy_hash=#{policy} AND (m.auth_kind='NONE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.connector_credential k WHERE k.space_id=m.space_id AND k.owner_user_id=m.owner_user_id AND k.id=m.credential_id AND k.revision=m.credential_revision AND k.state='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE OF k)) FOR SHARE OF c)
SELECT revision,enabled_version_id FROM pf.mcp_connector_activation WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND capability_id=#{connector}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.mcp_connector_activation(space_id,owner_user_id,capability_id) VALUES(#{actor.spaceId},#{actor.userId},#{connector}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.mcp_connector_activation SET enabled_version_id=#{version,jdbcType=OTHER},revision=revision+1 WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND capability_id=#{connector} AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT capability_id,action,version_id,expected_revision,result_revision,result_version_id FROM pf.mcp_activation_command WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.capability_audit(id,space_id,owner_user_id,action,resource_id,trace_id) VALUES(#{id},#{actor.spaceId},#{actor.userId},CASE WHEN #{command.action}='ENABLE' THEN 'CONNECTOR_ENABLED' ELSE 'CONNECTOR_DISABLED' END,#{command.connectorId},#{trace})
